upsert.title: DOG-FIGhT ferumoxytol radiosensitizer trial for canine glioma
upsert.center: University of Liverpool Small Animal Teaching Hospital
upsert.contacts: Prof. Tim Bentley — Tim.Bentley@liverpool.ac.uk; Small Animal Teaching Hospital — sath@liverpool.ac.uk
upsert.notes: University of Liverpool identifies DOG-FIGhT as Professor Bentley's current translational canine clinical trial. Dogs with glioma receive ferumoxytol before surgery; the study evaluates ferumoxytol as a glioma radiosensitizer and dogs also receive postoperative radiation therapy. Investigator prescreening is required to confirm the currently enrolling arm and eligibility before travel.
